messages:
alex (support): Uh heads up — multiple customers (notably acme-org) are seeing 5xx/gateway errors for the hosted inference API since ~07:10 UTC. Getting reports of intermittent 502/503 on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Example curl from customer:

alex (support): ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
* Connected to api.redwood.ai
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
< {"error":"control-plane: routing policy service returned 503"}
```

alex (support): Correlation ID = rwd-cc-2026-03-15-87a1, customer-side request_id: rpq-99821. They're seeing ~60% failures in last 10m.

maya (oncall-sre): :rotating_light: I'm seeing alerts too — routing-policy-service is spiking 5xx and hits to control-plane-auth show increased latency. Can you paste any X-Request-Id or the full response headers? Also linking alert: https://grafana/redwood/alerts/7632

ops-bot: Alert: routing-policy-service (prod) — 5xx rate > 15% in 5m. Top error: "configdb: read timeout (deadline exceeded)". Triggered at 2026-03-15T07:11:10Z.

raj (eng-platform): Pulling logs now. Quick check: routing-policy pods reporting repeated timeouts to configdb and auth-session. Relevant log snippet from routing-policy-3:

raj (eng-platform): ```
2026-03-15T07:10:58Z routing-policy service.go:214 error="rpc: call /configdb/GetPolicies failed: context deadline exceeded"
2026-03-15T07:11:02Z routing-policy store.go:89 warn="retrying configdb read (attempt 3)"
2026-03-15T07:11:05Z auth-session validator.go:47 error="auth validation upstream 503: session-db timeout"
```

maya (oncall-sre): That matches the DB timeouts. Could be either configdb overloaded or a network blip between control-plane and configdb cluster. Any deploys to configdb/service around 07:00-07:05?

raj (eng-platform): Checking deploy history: there was a config-db schema migration and a minor client upgrade rolled out at 06:58 UTC to configdb-staging and started progressive rollout to prod at 07:02 UTC. Rollout stuck at 30% due to readiness failures but there were partial instances running.

ellen (product): Customers are asking about billing and whether requests are being retried/charged. We need a short customer-facing note once we know scope. Also: any temporary mitigation we can offer (fallback region, alternate endpoint)?

maya (oncall-sre): Immediate mitigations:
- Flip routing-policy to use cached fallback rules (feature-flag) to avoid configdb reads: `console -> feature flags -> routing-policy.cache-only = true` (quick but may serve stale routing)
- Increase configdb read timeout to 5s temporarily in routing-policy (env var CONFIGDB_READ_TIMEOUT=5000)
- If it's a bad deploy, roll back configdb to previous version.

raj (eng-platform): Doing rollback now for the configdb rollout. Command:

raj (eng-platform): ```
kubectl -n controlplane rollout undo deploy/configdb --to-revision=42
kubectl -n controlplane scale deployment configdb --replicas=5
```

maya (oncall-sre): Also patched routing-policy to use cache-only for 10m while we stabilize:

maya (oncall-sre): ```
kubectl -n controlplane patch deployment routing-policy -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"routing-policy","env":[{"name":"ROUTING_CACHE_ONLY","value":"true"}]}]}}}}'
```

alex (support): After the patch I re-ran the customer's failing curl and they now see 200s for a small sample. Still seeing some auth/session failures for longer requests though.

ops-bot: Event: configdb rollback started by raj at 2026-03-15T07:18:12Z.

raj (eng-platform): Post-rollback logs show configdb latency back to normal and no more deadline exceeded. Sample:

raj (eng-platform): ```
2026-03-15T07:19:05Z configdb query.go:112 info="read OK, latency=48ms"
2026-03-15T07:19:06Z routing-policy service.go:214 info="policy fetch success"
```

maya (oncall-sre): Good. Leaving routing-policy cache-only for another 5m while we watch. Can ops confirm customer impact window and whether any billing anomalies were caused by retries? alex please coordinate with CS.

ellen (product): I'll draft a short note: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx observed between 07:10-07:20 UTC caused by a control-plane dependency failure (config DB read timeouts during a partial rollout). We mitigated by rolling back the rollout and enabling a cached fallback; services recovered by ~07:19 UTC. If you saw failed requests during that window, please open a ticket and we'll investigate billing/ retries." Thoughts?

alex (support): Sounds good. For the customer-facing ticket I will include repro steps, timeline, and note that we will review billing for impacted requests. Timeline I have:
- 07:02 UTC: configdb partial rollout started
- 07:10 UTC: routing-policy saw increased 5xx and customers saw 502/503
- 07:11-07:18 UTC: spike and mitigations (cache-only, timeout bump)
- 07:18 UTC: rollback initiated
- 07:19 UTC: services healthy, residual auth errors cleared by 07:22

maya (oncall-sre): Root cause summary: partial/failed configdb rollout introduced higher latency and readiness gaps, causing configdb read deadlines to be exceeded. That cascaded into routing-policy and auth-session errors which returned 5xx to API gateway. Action items:
- eng-platform: add rollout guardrail to prevent partial traffic to new configdb revision if readiness < 95%
- eng-runtime: add circuit breaker to routing-policy for configdb reads and prefer cache/fallback earlier
- s&c (support & cs): review billing for impacted customers and publish post-incident note

raj (eng-platform): I'll open a follow-up PR for the rollout guardrail and add a preflight that checks readiness across all AZs. Assigning to me and maya for validation.

ellen (product): I'll schedule a short postmortem doc and coordinate comms with support. Thanks all for fast triage.

alex (support): Customer update sent. Marking as resolved in the ticket for now; will re-open if we see any regression. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
